root_cause_label: Insufficient Image Analysis Before Solution Generation
one_sentence_failure_summary: After reading only 10 header lines of the reference PPM file, the agent wrongly assumed the image was a uniform blue field and generated a sinusoidal wave pattern with mismatched colors, never checking pixel-level similarity against the reference.
t_err_evidence: program uses sinusoidal gradient pattern instead of implementing ray-tracing to match reference scene
t_commit_evidence: The code written at step 4 defines the entire solution; all subsequent steps (5-10) only compile/run the code and check structural constraints (file size, line count), never the pixel similarity to the reference, so the failure is locked in at step 4.
t_surface_evidence: reconstructed pixels (128 220 200) visibly differ from reference pixels (159 197 255)
trigger_explanation: The agent read only 10 lines of a 4.3-million-line PPM file, which showed a near-uniform sky-blue region (~159,197,255), and falsely assumed this sample was representative of the entire path-traced image. Based on this false premise it wrote a generic sinusoidal pattern generator producing visually unrelated output.
